facts.fact: Drakken 赶到 Max 身边，对 Xander 点头说这支舞他要下了，等于当众把 Max 抢过来
facts.quote: He gave Xander a short nod. “King Xander, excuse us. I’ll be claiming this dance with my lady.”

facts.fact: Xander 用意志压向 Max 的意识，她的恶魔乘客顶住他的影响，让他的力量像油水一样滑落
facts.quote: It rose just far enough to set its shoulder against his influence, and his power slid off me like water off oiled steel

facts.fact: Max 从 Xander 口中套出关键情报：Missy 就在他位于旧城 Houston 的宫殿里
facts.quote: he’d let slip the one thing I needed: Missy was in his palace, in the old city they called Houston.

facts.fact: Caspian 打断舞步，声称他的舞伴欠他第一支舞，要从 Xander 手里把 Max 抢回来
facts.quote: “I’ll take it from here, Xander.” Caspian’s drawl had an edge under it like a blade still in its sheath.

facts.fact: Xander 当着全场宾客宣布 Max 是他的未婚妻，不许任何人碰他的未来女王
facts.quote: “I’m not dancing with some girl. I’m dancing with my betrothed. And I won’t allow a single soul to lay hands on my future queen.”

facts.fact: Xander 摊开受保护的羊皮血契，上面写着 Max 是 House Scorpio 与 House Capricorn 的女儿、落难继承人 Princess Trivia Morningstar，出生前即与他订约
facts.quote: the girl-child born of House Scorpio and House Capricorn, Princess Trivia Morningstar.

facts.fact: Max 在血契右下角看到第二个签名 Hecate、House Scorpio 族长，认出她就是 White Witch，也就是自己的母亲
Xander 用爪划开自己左前臂，Max 的左臂同一位置裂开同样伤口，性命被血契锁在一起，他随后以结盟或开战向 Zodiac Covenant 施压
facts.quote: There—on my left forearm, in the exact place he’d cut himself—a gash had opened in my skin
